description: This file defines the ClassDefinition class within the WPEFramework::JavaScript namespace, including methods for managing JavaScript class definitions, such as adding/removing functions and singleton instance management.

classes.name: ClassDefinition
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript class definition with methods to manage custom functions and singleton instances.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::ClassDefinition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes class name and extension name based on an identifier, converting to uppercase and lowercase respectively.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::getClassMap
methods.description: Returns a singleton static map of class definitions.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to a singleton ClassDefinition instance for a given class name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::Add
methods.description: Adds a JavaScriptFunction pointer to the class's custom functions list.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::Remove
methods.description: Removes a JavaScriptFunction pointer from the class's custom functions list.
